definitions.explanation: A situation where progress has completely stopped and neither side can advance. Used for negotiations, conflicts, competitions, and other situations where opposing forces are locked in place.

examples.japanese: ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{膠着|こうちゃく}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}った→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧。
examples.english: The negotiations fell into a deadlock.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{膠着|こうちゃく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧まま⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: The game entered the second half still in a stalemate.

examples.japanese: {与野党|よやとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対立|たいりつ}→対立：04500_tairitsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧⟦{審議|しんぎ}→審議：19112_shingi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{膠着|こうちゃく}し、⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成立|せいりつ}→成立：04353_seiritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見通|みとお}せない→見通す：18734_mitoosu⟧⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Due to the conflict between the ruling and opposition parties, parliamentary deliberations have deadlocked, and there is no prospect of passing important legislation.

notes:
WRITING:
{膠|こう} means "glue" (from animal hides), so the word literally evokes the image of things being stuck together and unable to move.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {膠着|こうちゃく}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧ (state of deadlock/stalemate)
- {膠着|こうちゃく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧ (fall into a stalemate)
- {膠着|こうちゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打破|だは}→打破：12808_daha⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (break a deadlock)
- {膠着|こうちゃく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{戦線|せんせん}→戦線：22999_sensen⟧ (stalled front line)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{行|い}き{詰|づ}まり→行き詰まり：08033_ikizumari⟧: deadlock, impasse (more everyday)
- ⟦{停滞|ていたい}→停滞：07427_teitai⟧: stagnation (emphasizes lack of progress; can be one-sided)
